arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='knip.json'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('],\n\t"ignoreDependencies": ["@commitlint/cli"]\n','],\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat knip.json; npx oxfmt --check knip.json && npm run analyze 2>&1 | tail -3 && git add knip.json && git commit -q --amend --no-edit --no-verify && npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo check=$?
